title: Four Palestinians killed, including UNRWA employee, in Israeli attacks across Gaza
summary_or_snippet: WAFA reported that four Palestinians, including UNRWA employee Adel Sami al-Helou, were killed in Israeli attacks and gunfire across Gaza since dawn; it said three Palestinians were killed when Israeli aircraft targeted a civilian vehicle near Ansar Roundabout west of Gaza City, with several others injured.
traceability_note: Traceable to the direct WAFA article URL dated 2026-11-23T18:15:00+00:00. This record is the controlling WAFA vehicle-strike report for the edition and is not merged with the November 21 Tel al-Hawa incident.

title: Gaza child dies from lead poisoning, medical sources confirm
summary_or_snippet: WAFA reported that medical sources in Gaza announced a child's death from acute lead poisoning and linked the case to unsafe battery repair in displacement camps and tents, while noting that limited supplies and testing capacity may leave other cases undiagnosed.
traceability_note: Traceable to the direct WAFA article URL dated 2026-11-23T10:38:00+00:00. It is a distinct health-related source report and is not used to add any vehicle-strike or Tel al-Hawa casualty count.
